name: llm-captcha-solver

scripts.e2e: bun run build && vitest run test/e2e --reporter=default --reporter=json --outputFile.json=out/reports/e2e.json; code=$?; bun src/tools/benchmark/record-verified.ts out/reports/e2e.json; exit $code
scripts.check: bun run typecheck && bun run test && bun run e2e
scripts.live: bun run build && vitest run test/live --reporter=default --reporter=json --outputFile.json=out/reports/live.json; code=$?; bun src/tools/benchmark/record-verified.ts out/reports/live.json; exit $code

description: Solves CAPTCHAs with a vision model of your choice for AI browser agents: Chrome extension + CDP library (Playwright, Puppeteer), with replayable fixtures, failure reports and self-updates.
